bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os,tempfile
p=Path("scripts/userbot_test_client.py")
s=p.read_text()
old='{"list_joined_public_channels", "list_channel_videos", "download_channel_video"}:'
new='{"list_joined_public_channels", "list_channel_videos", "download_channel_video", "download_channel_video_step"}:'
if s.count(old)!=1:raise RuntimeError("JSON_OUTPUT_ALLOWLIST_ANCHOR_CHANGED")
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
compile(s,str(p),"exec")
fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".public-video-cli-",dir=str(p.parent))
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd,"w") as f:f.write(s)
    os.chmod(tmp,0o644)
    os.replace(tmp,p)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)
print("VIDEO_STEP_CLI_JSON=ENABLED")
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
before=$(stat -c %s /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443/800.partial)
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py download_channel_video_step --channel-id 1877875443 --message-id 800 --json
if test -f /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443/800.partial;then
after=$(stat -c %s /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443/800.partial)
else
after=$(stat -c %s /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos/1877875443/800.mp4)
fi
echo BEFORE_BYTES="$before"
echo AFTER_BYTES="$after"
test "$after" -gt "$before"
echo RESUMED_BYTES_CONFIRMED=YES
